verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Drata has a public API v2, an OAuth setup article, and an MCP server guide, but only as titles; nothing documents scoped, least-privilege, or read-only API credentials that could be issued to an agent. The drata-agent's 'READ ONLY access to your system preferences' describes a desktop device agent's OS permissions, an adjacent feature rather than API credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
